items.name: ASSIST Cubing 2020
items.information:
Contributions
At the registration you can support the association "Asociatia Romana de Speedcubing" with a contribution and you will get a cubing prize. More details on http://www.speedcubing.ro

Lunch
The main sponsor will provide some sandwiches/snacks.
You can walk arround at the restaurants and shops. 

Prizes
Certificates and medals for top 3 of each event.
Cubes from our sponsor ASSIST.

items.name: Slovenian Nationals 2020
items.information:
This competition is recognized as Slovenian Championships. Slovenian citizens will get Slovenian champion titles. 

Tekmovanje šteje za državno prvenstvo, tako da lahko slovenski tekmovalc osvojijo naslov državnega prvaka.

items.name: Southern Utah Spring 2020

venue.name: Red Lion Hotel and Conference Center
venue.address: 850 South Bluff Street St. George UT 84770

items.information:
* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* No outside food and drink.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with most of the information you need.

items.name: Central Oregon Spring 2020
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CentralOregonSpring2020#13193-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

**Join our facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!**
